loss_normalization: Each space divided by fixed ordinary-teacher per-coordinate variance in that same space; computed on single-step training states only. No composite target or answer in fitting.
nullspace: Orthogonal complement of all fixed numeric readout rows. Forward and backward PermWorld geometry use the same projector; existing bidirectional and forward-only domain protocols retained.
predictions: Primary: matrix correct-minus-wrong collision compound-accuracy advantage is larger under nullspace than fullspace geometry.
Supporting: null emphasis reduces actual null-only margin-crossing errors for correct pairing more than wrong pairing.
PermWorld is a second domain confirmation; no positive cross-domain outcome assumed. Report each source and failed single-generator gates.
test_policy: All twelve fixed-budget fits per domain complete before that domain compound test opens. No selection on compound outcomes. Three new source initializations, one independent support pool each.

permworld.source_data_scope: New ordinary source seeds, existing supervised source corpus; this is initialization replication, not new-source-corpus replication. Adaptation/test inputs fresh and whole-orbit excluded from all local archived datasets.

matrix.test_novelty: Fresh split excludes all previously examined v3 matrix test group orbits from the entire new experiment. New source/validation/fit/test group orbits mutually disjoint. Old training orbits can recur under new models and are not claimed unseen across all historical work.

scope: Prospective directional-loss intervention after old-model diagnostics. New source seeds and tests; fixed architecture, output labels/KD, input marginals, schedules, and budget across four arms. Only geometric direction and matched correspondence vary. Three independent source clusters; architecture and involution assumptions differ between legacy domains.
